_comment: GOLDEN v2, 30 min HEALTH-CHECK arm — identical posture and identical armed set to
_golden305_gps.json (305-station / 303 in-network GPS-only, DOY-129, 30 s, deg-15
single-layer SH, lane_carry OFF, full Aug-04 LASER instrumentation tier + emission-
observability candidate + the three improvement arms), duration cut to 30 min with its
own fresh output lineage.  Nothing else differs — do NOT re-tune knobs here.
PURPOSE: confirm everything is wired and live at 305 stations.  Read the run-end
counters for every armed instrument — prires families (pl/zwd read 0 rows WITH the named
WARN on this carry_invariant posture; that is the correct printed outcome, not a defect),
mdb rows binned, block_baarda n_blocks + size histogram, datum_graph components (GPS-only
is the CONTROL regime: expect k=1 and zero tier-2 predictions), congruence stations swept.
An ABSENT counter block means that card is not in the build you ran — unknown JSON keys
are silently ignored (invariant #4), so absence is never 'quiet'.
PARALLELISM: already fully parallel via the inherited chain (_ft63_24h_conv.json):
eigen_threads 20, parallel_stations true, parallel_min_stations 8, parallel_max_threads 0
(= all 20 logical cores), parallel_seam true, parallel_carry true.  That is every parallel
knob the producer has except:
- network.parallel_reduce — DELIBERATELY OFF.  MUTEX with parallel_carry:
GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:974 silently forces parallel_carry OFF when both are set.
The Card-4 carry's dense algebra is ~80 % of a 305-station epoch and pcarry is the
~2.4x win, so arming preduce makes the run SLOWER.  Do not arm it.
- lane_carry.parallel_components / fold_blocked — INERT (lane_carry.enable is false).
There is no further parallelism to buy in config.
EXPECTED WALL: ~4 min ingest (303 stations) + 61 epochs at the measured 26.9 s/epoch
= ~27 min, so ~31 min total IF RUN ALONE.  Measured on the 3 h arm 2026-08-04: the full
instrumentation tier costs ~1 % (26.9 vs the 26.7 s/epoch reference for the same posture
without the riders), settled epoch time is FLAT (shared cols pinned at 567-568), and the
attributed epoch is cov-consumers 48 %, solve-glue 22 %, install-post 13 %, dd-build 7 %,
assembly 6 %, reduce 2 %, normal-equation solve 0.06 %.
⚠️ CONCURRENCY: measured on the same box (10-core / 20-thread i9-9820X) — a sibling
session's ~10 min build+test run cost the in-flight 305 arm 17 % (26.8 -> 31.3 s/epoch),
visible as assembly-wall +30 %, addStation +31 %, reduce +37 % while dd-build stayed flat.
Use a uniquely renamed exe so the linker never hits a locked binary, and expect the wall
estimate above to stretch if anything else is running.
⚠️ SCOPE: 30 min is a wiring/health check.  It CANNOT grade total_IF (the LEVEL channel
needs ~2 h on this lineage), the lane-off carry-RETENTION question, or the held-out
WTZZ00DEU consumer trace.  Do not quote those from this run.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: this config arms fingerprinted knobs, so it must converge fresh.
Its output paths are its own — never resume it onto another arm's snapshot.
